title: bot.ability.processing.input
description: One turn the cognition hands a long-lived deliberative tier, reasoning or intuition (abilities/reasoning/reasoning.scx) [floppy fields; mosfet.py's Processing input].

turn.description: The body's processing turn this event belongs to, counted from 1 [floppy field].

focus.description: Instance name the bot is looking at, if any.

focus_candidates.description: Instance names that may become focus for this turn.

choices.description: The turn's choices within the tier's effort ceiling: {event, schema, description?, target?} each.

held.description: The actions held from this tier, over its effort ceiling: {event, description?} each.

self.description: What the bot knows of itself, or null.

acted.description: What earlier stages already did on the turn.

recent.description: The recent turns of the bot's conversations.

max_context_tokens.description: The model's context window in tokens, or null to fit nothing.

completion_reserve_tokens.description: The tokens reserved for the model's reply.

bytes_per_token.description: The fewest request bytes a token any reply showed so far.
